method: Eliminate options (figures): common face on dice
steps: L is on the front in both views, so J, K, M, O form the ring around L.
The only letter not adjacent to L is N, so N is opposite L.
J, M, K are all adjacent to L and to N's ring positions (eliminate A, C, D).
check_code:
import itertools
pairs=[('J','K'),('M','O')]   # L on front in both views; (top,right)
sols=set()
for a,b in itertools.permutations(['M','O']):
    ring=['J','K',a,b]
    if all(any(ring[i]==p and ring[(i+1)%4]==q for i in range(4)) for p,q in pairs):
        sols.add(frozenset(ring))
assert len(sols)==1
ring_faces=sols.pop()
others=set('JKLMNO')-ring_faces
# the ring around L excludes L and its opposite; N is not in the ring so N is opposite L
assert others=={'L','N'}
ans='L'
opts={'A':'J','B':'L','C':'M','D':'K'}
assert ans==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert ans!=opts[k]
